item.title: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
item.description: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

item.title: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
item.description: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
item.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The U.S. last held a public execution in the 1930s. The Pentagon wants to change that
item.description: The Pentagon says it will livestream the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan at Fort Hood, the site of his 2009 mass shooting. That would be the first public execution in the U.S. since the 1930s.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Getty Images)

item.title: Why American investors love European defense startups
item.description: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.
